title: Automating scientific annotations for open transcriptomic profiles via multi-stage agents

live_model.evidence: "GPT-4.1 nano had the lowest estimated API cost but did not produce complete outputs for all benchmark samples"; excluded from the 5 models chosen for prospective evaluation.

claim.metric: none (GPT-4.1 nano did not complete the benchmark and was dropped before the accuracy/concordance evaluation; only cost/runtime is reported for it)

data.source: GEO Series transcriptomic profiles (public GEO records); the internal 118-sample benchmark/annotation set itself not confirmed released

notes: 22 frontier LLMs were screened on cost/runtime/completeness; GPT-4.1 nano is flagged as failing to complete all benchmark samples and was dropped before the accuracy/concordance evaluation, so no capability number exists for it.
